correctness.rationale: A direct infinite-n classification distinguishes the three nonempty layer case, the full-middle-layer case, and the middle-empty covering condition. Distance-three incompatibility gives exactly 2n exclusions. For deletion-minimality, every overlap is removable except when an outer singleton forces a full opposite layer, with six extra n=3 cases. Symbolic coefficient expansion and an independently implemented brute-force distance/neighbor test agree on 37,376 subsets for n=3,4,5. Finite verification supplements but does not replace the full proof; all boundary cases n=3 and n=4 are handled.

value.rationale: The two polynomials give the entire feasible-set distribution and the complete deletion-minimal monitoring spectrum of a simple, naturally parametrized Cartesian product. The optimizer multiplicity, exceptional n=3 configurations, and the unbounded n-2 upper-minus-minimum semitotal gap provide a structural refinement of established graph invariants, not a routine numerical optimization or arbitrary finite slice. The result is potentially useful for enumerating redundant and irredundant monitoring configurations on three-layer clique paths.
